title: Implicit conversions through constructors (slide 118)
expectedStdout:
foo(Nombre 3)
sending order at 100.5 for 7 shares
tryThis: Add `explicit` to `Price(double)`: the call with the arguments swapped no longer compiles, which catches the bug.
Add `explicit` to `Nombre(int)`: `foo( 3 )` fails, and you must write `foo( Nombre{ 3 } )`.
